description: 100V input, 1A synchronous buck DC/DC converter, ultra-low IQ, COT control

pinout.name: VIN
pinout.notes: Regulator supply input to high-side FET and internal bias regulator. Connect directly to input supply with short, low-impedance paths.

pinout.name: EN/UVLO
pinout.notes: Precision enable and UVLO programming pin. <1.1V shutdown, 1.1-1.5V standby (VCC reg on, no switching), >1.5V start-up.

pinout.name: RON
pinout.notes: On-time programming pin; resistor to GND sets buck switch on-time

pinout.name: FB
pinout.notes: Feedback input of voltage regulation comparator

pinout.name: PGOOD
pinout.notes: Power good indicator, open-drain output. Pull up externally with 10k-100k ohm resistor.

pinout.name: BST
pinout.notes: Bootstrap gate-drive supply. Requires 2.2nF 50V X7R ceramic capacitor between BST and SW.

pinout.name: SW
pinout.notes: Switching node, internally connected to source of high-side NMOS and drain of low-side NMOS synchronous rectifier. Connect to power inductor.

pinout.name: EP
pinout.notes: Exposed pad, no internal electrical connection. Connect EP to GND pin and to a large copper plane to reduce thermal resistance.

decoupling.value: low-ESR ceramic bypass capacitor, high-quality dielectric
decoupling.placement: as close as possible to VIN and GND pins
decoupling.notes: Datasheet typical application shows CIN 2.2uF; add 10uF electrolytic in parallel for damping if long input cable/PCB trace impedance is present (typical ESR 0.5 ohm).
Required to bias the internal high-side gate driver. Abs max external BST-to-SW capacitance range is 1.5nF-2.5nF; recommended operating value is 2.2nF.

land_pattern.notes: From TI DDA0008B example board layout (land pattern), 4214849/B 09/2025. Exposed thermal pad land: solder mask opening 2.71mm x 3.4mm; copper pad approx 2.95mm x 4.9mm (metal may vary per creepage requirement, note 9). Vias under the thermal pad are optional per datasheet; if implemented, recommended to fill/plug/tent them. pad_count counts the exposed pad (EP=GND), as the footprint does.

layout_notes: Bypass VIN to GND with a low-ESR ceramic capacitor placed as close as possible to VIN and GND pins; ground both input and output capacitors with localized top-side planes connecting to GND pin and GND pad.
Minimize the loop area formed by the input capacitor connections to VIN and GND pins.
Locate the inductor close to the SW pin; minimize SW trace/plane area to prevent excessive capacitive coupling.
Tie the GND pin directly to the power pad under the device and to a heat-sinking PCB ground plane.
Use a ground plane in an inner layer (layer 2, below the power stage) for noise shielding and heat dissipation.
Use a single-point ground connection to the plane; route feedback, RON, and enable component grounds to the ground plane to keep switched/load currents out of analog ground traces.
Make VIN, VOUT, and ground bus connections as wide as possible to reduce voltage drops and maximize efficiency.
Minimize trace length to the FB pin; place feedback resistors RFB1/RFB2 close to FB. Route VOUT sense away from noisy nodes, preferably on a layer separated by a grounded shielding layer.
Package is designed to be soldered to a thermal pad on the board (PowerPAD); connect the exposed pad to GND and to a large copper plane / heat-sinking ground plane to reduce thermal resistance.
